newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa gently firms but seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa gently firms but seen consolidating.

text.p: MAY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures are slowly gathering momentum to recover from the sharp slide seen earlier this week but may still need to consolidate further, technical analysts said on Friday.

London's spot May contract is still struggling to claw back ground lost after a fund-led sell-off on Monday dragged the position down by some five percent and through the bottom of a three-week range.
But upward progress has been slow since then, although 960 stg support from the November/December trading area has held so far.
"It has had a reasonable push up but it's not really breaking back into that area," said Susan Rigg, a technical analyst at Chart Analysis.
"I would have said it's going to have to move back above 1,020 to say this is now a downward break and it's going back to the highs again," she said.
Traders called the London market to open broadly unchanged from Thursday's close.
The market was finally showing signs of fatigue on the downside after testing the week's lows several times with little follow-through, they said.
Fund players were looking sold out and origins already well-sold for their crop so neither side was likely to put barriers in the way of an upside move.
"It's more likely that it will range sideways...but it may have to do some work above that area (960 support) before it can get back to the highs," Rigg said.
"It may range higher but it's going to have a lot of difficulty making an aggressive further advance."
Analysts pointed to more chart support at two Fibonacci retracements at 957 and 935 stg, the 50 and 61.8 percent levels based on the rally from February's 855 stg to this month's peak at 1,050 stg.
